text: Mubadala Capital, the asset-management subsidiary of Abu Dhabi's Mubadala Investment Company, became the controlling shareholder of Brazilian biofuel producer Atvos through its MC Green Energy investment fund, and lists Atvos as a current Brazil portfolio investment.
short: Atvos controlled by Mubadala Capital funds

source.name: Valor International (O Globo): Mubadala to take over Atvos after agreement with creditors
source.quote: Mubadala will become the controlling shareholder through the MC Green Energy fund, and there is another vehicle, Agroenergia FIP Multiestratégia, which will hold a 5% stake.

additionalSources.name: Mubadala Capital: Special Opportunities – Brazil (portfolio page)
additionalSources.quote: We acquired a significant stake in sugarcane-to-ethanol business Atvos, the 2nd largest ethanol player in Brazil, from creditors, combined with a debt restructuring.

additionalSources.name: Latin Lawyer: Novonor exits Atvos with Mubadala sale
additionalSources.quote: Mubadala Capital acquire the remaining 10% stake that Brazilian conglomerate Novonor held in local ethanol producer Atvos
